description: List sales pipeline opportunities/deals. Shows prospects, their stage, value, and next actions.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

status.description: Which deals to return, judged by the pipeline stage: "active" = still in play (default), "won" = in a closed-won stage, "lost" = in a closed-lost stage, "all" = every deal. This is NOT the project delivery status.

name: list_opportunities
title: List Opportunities
